text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ ۚ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًۭا ۖ وَإِن تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهْتَدُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًۭا

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction that pivots from the prior messenger-and-mockery statement into a fresh rhetorical accusation
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the discourse after the prior statement about messengers, warnings, and mockery. It opens the rhetorical case file in which refusal, forgetting, covered hearts, burdened ears, and failed guidance all become evidence for the opening indictment.

topics.headline: resumptive opening of the indictment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins a new accusatory unit while still carrying forward the prior scene of rejected warnings.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar and CRITICAL rows identify the particle as resumptive rather than a simple additive connector; the discourse rows tie it to the transition from 18:56 into the worst-wrongdoer question.

words.gloss_range: interrogative-relative pronoun forming a no-one-is-more construction and opening a singular type that can represent a wider class
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) sets up the rhetorical question whose force is "no one." The singular profile does not stay merely individual; it lets one offender stand for the broader class that will later be named with plural hearts, ears, and pronouns. As part of a recurring worst-wrongdoer formula (6:21, 6:93, 7:37, 10:17, 11:18, 18:15, 29:68, 32:22, 39:32, 61:7), this instance defines the offense by rejecting received signs.

topics.headline: rhetorical singular archetype
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a formally singular figure becomes a recurring worst-wrongdoer archetype for everyone who answers signs with refusal.
topics.reason: The grammar supports subject function in the elative construction, while discourse rows show the singular archetype carrying the plural denier class from the prior ayah.

words.gloss_range: elative verdict of maximal wrong after reminder; darkness and misplacement pressure survive, while the local sense remains wrongdoing rather than a separate darkness noun
words.root_gloss_range: root range joining wrongdoing, injustice, wrong placement, and darkness; locally the elative selects maximal wrongdoing with perceptual-darkness pressure
words.prose: {{ar:أَظْلَمُ}} ({{tr:aẓlamu}}) is an elative verdict: the described person is not simply wrong but placed at the limit of wrong. The nominal frame states the classification before the evidence sequence unfolds, and the following comparison pulls the whole relative profile into the judgment. The root pressure of darkness remains useful because the ayah will move from moral misplacement to covered hearts, heavy ears, and failed guidance, but local grammar keeps the word as a ranked wrongdoing verdict.

topics.headline: maximal wrongdoing with darkness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation is not generic injustice; it ranks refusal after evidence as the outer edge of wrongdoing and anticipates blocked perception.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an elative predicate completed by the following comparison; V4/root evidence permits darkness pressure but local grammar selects the moral elative sense.

words.gloss_range: comparative preposition after the elative, joining the comparison to the whole following offender profile
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) supplies the comparison required by the elative. In the contracted frame, the person compared against is defined by the whole sequence that follows: reminded by signs, then turning away and forgetting.

topics.headline: comparison tied to the relative profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison is measured against a full profile of acts, not against an isolated label.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows identify comparative min after the elative and its fusion with the following relative profile.

words.gloss_range: Form II passive perfect of being reminded or made to remember by means of the Lord's signs, with intensified received communication before refusal
words.root_gloss_range: root range of remembering, mention, reminder, and record; locally the passive Form II selects being emphatically reminded
words.prose: {{ar:ذُكِّرَ}} ({{tr:dhukkira}}) makes the first action received, not initiated. The signs are the medium through which the reminder reaches the person, while the passive leaves the reminding agent open to God, messengers, signs, or recitation. The root spans memory, mention, and record, so only after substantial received reminder does the person turn away and forget.

topics.headline: passive reminder before active rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rebellion is not the first move; the person is first made a recipient of reminder.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form II passive perfect with the subject carried by the offender; attachment evidence ties the reminder to the signs, and CRITICAL rows connect it to the later forgetting.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition marking the signs as the means of reminder and the first contact point with evidence
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the reminder to the signs as its means. That first contact makes the later movement away from the same signs sharper: access is given before distance is chosen.

topics.headline: signs as reminder medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are not merely a topic of speech; they are the medium through which reminder reaches the person.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment rows identify instrumental force after the passive reminder; CRITICAL rows trace the later prepositional reversal from contact to aversion.

words.gloss_range: plural construct signs, verses, and proofs belonging to the Lord and later gathered by a singular collective pronoun; alternate root pressure is kept cautious
words.root_gloss_range: root range for sign or marker, with a reported alternative return/shelter pressure; locally the construct selects signs, verses, and proofs as evidence
words.prose: {{ar:آيَاتِ}} ({{tr:āyāti}}) names the signs as both reminder-medium and later rejected object. The plural is gathered as a single body of evidence, and the construct with the Lord makes ownership and source operate together before refusal becomes directional. The wider sign, verse, and proof range survives, so turning from the signs refuses both the markers and what they point beyond themselves; root-dispute pressure remains secondary.

topics.headline: Lord-linked signs as unified evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rejected object is a unified evidentiary field tied to the Lord, not scattered data.
topics.reason: QAC shows the genitive construct and later pronoun antecedent; contextual rows support signs as evidence, verses, and proofs, while contested root material is not allowed to replace the local sign sense.

words.gloss_range: singular possessive Lord in construct with signs, making the evidence personally related before the later pluralized sealing
words.root_gloss_range: root range of lordship, ownership, nurturing, and bringing to completion; locally it frames the signs as from the person's own Lord
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهِ}} ({{tr:rabbihi}}) closes the reminder phrase by naming the signs as those of his own sustaining Lord, not neutral data. The singular suffix keeps the archetype personally accountable before the ayah expands into the plural group with covered hearts and burdened ears.

topics.headline: his Lord as personal source of signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rejected signs come from his own Lord, intensifying refusal as relational rejection.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the possessive construct and suffix reference; CRITICAL rows preserve both lordship and cultivation pressure without changing the local possessive relation.

words.gloss_range: consecutive particle marking the turning-away as the prompt response to reminder
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the turn away follow the reminder as immediate response. The grammar tightens the moral sequence: reminder arrives, then rejection follows without a narrated interval.

topics.headline: immediate response marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the text leaves no neutral pause between evidence and aversion.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows identify taqib or immediate consecutive force between the passive reminder and the active turning-away.

words.gloss_range: Form IV completed act of aversion from the signs, with physical broadside imagery; wider honor or worldly-goods branches remain background pressure
words.root_gloss_range: root range of width, presentation, side, honor, goods, and turning aside; locally Form IV with the following preposition selects active aversion
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْرَضَ}} ({{tr:aʿraḍa}}) gives rejection a bodily geometry: after being reminded, the person actively turns his side from the signs. The root's width and broadside pressure helps the image, while honor or worldly-goods associations stay as secondary contrast rather than the selected local sense.

topics.headline: active turning away from signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices turning away as a chosen orientation of the self, not mere failure to understand.
topics.reason: QAC identifies Form IV governing the following prepositional object; V4 and CRITICAL evidence allow broadside image-pressure but do not license all root branches as local meanings.

words.gloss_range: prepositional phrase marking distance from the same signs and gathering them as one collective object
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْهَا}} ({{tr:ʿanhā}}) completes the rejection vector. The pronoun gathers the many signs as one body of evidence, while the preposition marks distance after the earlier contact made by the reminder.

topics.headline: separation from the collective signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact object of aversion: the person turns from the signs that had just served as reminder.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows identify the preposition plus feminine singular pronoun as referring back to the plural signs as a collective antecedent.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that adds forgetting as a second offense after active turning away
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds a second failure to the first. After the immediate active turn from signs, the conjunction lets forgetting accumulate as another layer of culpability: active aversion is followed by passive loss rather than explained away by it.

topics.headline: forgetting added to aversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that forgetting is stacked on top of turning away rather than used to excuse it.
topics.reason: QAC and discourse rows identify additive coordination between the active aversion and the following forgetting clause.

words.gloss_range: perfect verb of forgetting or neglecting what the person's own hands sent forward, preserving ambiguity between memory lapse and abandonment
words.root_gloss_range: root range of forgetting, neglecting, and leaving behind; locally it selects culpable loss of one's own forwarded deeds after reminder
words.prose: {{ar:نَسِيَ}} ({{tr:nasiya}}) turns received reminder into a completed state of culpable loss. The same actor who turned away now forgets, and the verb can carry both forgetting and abandonment; the object narrows the loss to what the person's own agency had already sent ahead.

topics.headline: forgetting as culpable loss after reminder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reversal: the one made to remember becomes the one who forgets his own record.
topics.reason: QAC shows the verb governing the following relative clause; CRITICAL memory-pair rows support the reminder-forgetting reversal, while root ambiguity is kept within the local object frame.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun functioning as the object of forgetting and leaving the forwarded content broad
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) does not name the deeds directly. It opens a broad relative clause, so the forgotten object is whatever the hands had advanced, with no narrowing to one kind of act.

topics.headline: open object of forgotten deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the forgotten record is left open enough to cover the whole output of the person's agency.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the pronoun as object of the forgetting verb, and CRITICAL rows preserve the openness of the relative reference.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect of causing something to go forward, making prior acts a deposited record awaiting the person
words.root_gloss_range: root range of precedence, advance, prior placement, and oldness; locally it selects sending deeds forward into accountability
words.prose: {{ar:قَدَّمَتْ}} ({{tr:qaddamat}}) makes the forgotten object a prior deposit. The Form II verb images agency as something actively sent ahead, so forgetting does not erase the deed; it only blinds the person to what has already gone before him.

topics.headline: deeds deposited ahead
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices time turning against the person: past agency has already been sent ahead to meet him.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment rows identify the relative clause and hand subject; CRITICAL formula rows link the expression to judgment contexts while keeping the local focus on the forward deposit.

words.gloss_range: dual possessed hands as the grammatical agent of what was sent forward, imaging complete personal agency
words.root_gloss_range: root range of hand, power, means, and agency; locally the dual hands stand for the person's full produced record
words.prose: {{ar:يَدَاهُ}} ({{tr:yadāhu}}) closes the first beat on the person's own instruments of action. The dual form and possessive suffix make the agency complete and personal, balancing the Lord's signs against the offender's own output.

topics.headline: two hands as complete agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices accountability becoming embodied: the forgotten record comes from his own two hands.
topics.reason: QAC shows the dual noun as subject of the preceding verb with possessive suffix; CRITICAL rows preserve the idiom of hands as visible agency.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle with first-person plural pronoun, shifting from offender profile to divine causal assertion
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) changes the register. After the human sequence of reminder, aversion, and forgetting, the emphatic divine "We" introduces the placement of barriers as an asserted cause, not speculation.

topics.headline: emphatic divine pivot to explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivoting from accusation to a stated divine explanation for why response now fails.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the emphatic particle plus first-person plural pronoun; discourse rows mark the transition from rhetorical accusation to divine assertion.

words.gloss_range: broad perfect making and placing verb governing coverings on hearts and, by ellipsis, heaviness in ears
words.root_gloss_range: root range of making, placing, rendering, assigning, and setting; locally one divine act sets two perception blockages
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}) governs the sealing beat. Its first-person plural ending makes the divine actor explicit, and its broad making-and-placing force can carry both surface coverings on hearts and internal heaviness in ears. Cognition and reception are therefore blocked under one asserted divine action, with the repeated verb elided but still governing the ears clause.

topics.headline: one making verb for two blocked faculties
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that heart-covering and ear-heaviness are coordinated as one divine act across two faculties.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence show the verb governing the first object and carrying into the coordinated ears clause; CRITICAL rows connect this to repeated sealing formulas.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking surface or over-placement of coverings on hearts
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) gives the heart blockage spatial shape. The coverings rest upon hearts, creating an over-layer that contrasts with the later weight placed inside the ears.

topics.headline: coverings upon hearts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the heart obstruction as an imposed layer upon the organ, contrasted with the internal heaviness of ears.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows identify the preposition as surface placement and contrast it with the later internal preposition.

words.gloss_range: plural possessed hearts under the surface-covering phrase, shifting from singular archetype to plural group and marking cognition rather than emotion alone
words.root_gloss_range: root range of turning, flipping, and heart as inner center; locally the covered hearts are comprehension centers prevented from turning toward understanding
words.prose: {{ar:قُلُوبِهِمْ}} ({{tr:qulūbihim}}) is where the singular profile becomes a plural diagnosis. The hearts are not merely emotional organs here; the following blocked comprehension shows them as centers of discernment, and the root pressure of turning makes the coverings feel like a prevention of reorientation.

topics.headline: plural hearts as covered comprehension centers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the singular wrongdoer expanding into a class exactly where the inner center of comprehension is named.
topics.reason: QAC shows the plural possessed noun governed by the surface preposition; contextual and CRITICAL rows tie hearts to comprehension, the singular-to-plural shift, and same-surah heart contrasts.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural object of the making verb, imaging multiple coverings whose function is to prevent deep comprehension
words.root_gloss_range: root range of covering, concealment, shelter, and encasement; locally the covering sense is inverted from protection into disabling concealment
words.prose: {{ar:أَكِنَّةً}} ({{tr:akinnatan}}) names the placed barrier before the blocked outcome is stated. Its indefinite broken plural makes the obstruction feel layered, and the root's sheltering or precious-concealment possibilities are inverted here into an encasement that prevents comprehension.

topics.headline: layered coverings against comprehension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the barrier itself standing between hearts and understanding, not just an abstract refusal to know.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the accusative object of the making verb and the following purpose/result clause; V4 and CRITICAL rows support k-n-n concealment pressure while local syntax selects disabling heart-coverings.

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle introducing the prevented or resulting act of comprehension
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) links the placed coverings to the failed act that follows. The particle lets the clause read as purpose or result, but either way it makes blocked comprehension the function of the barrier.

topics.headline: purpose-result link to blocked comprehension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the coverings are not decorative imagery; their function is explicitly tied to preventing understanding.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle governing the subjunctive verb; CRITICAL rows preserve the purpose-result ambiguity without changing the local dependency.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive imperfect of deep comprehension with an attached open object pronoun, subordinated to the prevention clause
words.root_gloss_range: root range of penetrating understanding and discernment; locally it names comprehension that the heart-coverings prevent
words.prose: {{ar:يَفْقَهُوهُ}} ({{tr:yafqahūhu}}) states what the coverings prevent. The attached object remains broad enough to include the reminder, signs, truth, or recited message, while the root points to deep comprehension rather than bare hearing.

topics.headline: deep comprehension blocked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is blocked is not mere exposure to words, but penetrating understanding of the whole reminder field.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the subjunctive verb with plural subject and suffix; CRITICAL and parallel rows support the open pronoun and the close formula with heart-coverings.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the ears clause to the heart-covering clause as a paired perception blockage
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the second organ to the sealing statement. Hearts with coverings and ears with heaviness become twin components of the same blocked perception complex.

topics.headline: ears added as second sealed channel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the blockage doubling from comprehension to reception.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows identify coordination of the ears clause with the heart-covering clause under the same larger divine placement.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking internal location of auditory heaviness inside the ears
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) shifts the spatial geometry. The hearts had coverings upon them; the ears receive heaviness inside them, making the auditory obstruction internal to the channel of reception.

topics.headline: heaviness inside ears
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ear blockage is not an outside cover but an internal weight inside the hearing channel.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows identify the preposition as internal placement and contrast it with the previous surface preposition.

words.gloss_range: plural possessed ears as the internal location of heaviness and the reception channel paired with hearts
words.root_gloss_range: root range of ear, hearing, permission, access, and announcement; locally the ears are auditory access channels blocked before the call
words.prose: {{ar:آذَانِهِمْ}} ({{tr:ādhānihim}}) names the reception channel after the comprehension center. The root's permission and access pressure sharpens the image: the call will be directed toward them, but the channel that would admit it is already burdened.

topics.headline: ears as blocked access channels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices why the coming call cannot land: the receiving organ has already been made heavy.
topics.reason: QAC shows the plural possessed noun governed by the internal preposition; CRITICAL rows pair ears with hearts, hearing, permission pressure, and the later call.

words.gloss_range: accusative mass-like verbal noun for heaviness in ears, parallel to heart-coverings and carrying load/deafness pressure
words.root_gloss_range: root range of weight, heaviness, deafness, gravity, dignity, and burden; locally the ear-heaviness sense is selected, with dignity/load pressure inverted
words.prose: {{ar:وَقْرًا}} ({{tr:waqran}}) completes the second blockage with a load-image. The singular indefinite names heaviness as a condition filling many ears; dignity or grave-weight associations survive only as ironic pressure, because locally the weight deafens rather than ennobles.

topics.headline: heaviness burdening hearing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hearing failure as a weight inside the ear, not just unwillingness described abstractly.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the accusative object carried by the making verb; V4 and CRITICAL rows support the ear-heaviness formula and require narrowing broader dignity or load branches to image-pressure.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the final conditional unit after the sealing diagnosis
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the final structural beat. After the accusation and the sealing explanation, the discourse now tests the condition by imagining a call toward guidance.

topics.headline: conditional test introduced
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from diagnosis to a test case: even a call toward guidance will fail.
topics.reason: QAC and discourse rows identify the particle as resumptive, opening the conditional unit that proves the prior blockage.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle that opens a hypothetical call, immediately answered by emphatic permanent negation
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) frames the call as a condition. The protasis leaves room to imagine the attempt, but the apodosis will answer with emphatic non-arrival, making the structure itself enact futility.

topics.headline: conditional possibility before impossibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammar briefly opening a possible route only so the answer can close it completely.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the conditional particle governing the following jussive verb; CRITICAL rows contrast the opened condition with the following absolute negation.

words.gloss_range: second-person masculine singular jussive verb of calling, inviting, or summoning the plural sealed group toward guidance
words.root_gloss_range: root range of calling, summoning, inviting, invoking, and claim-making; locally it selects directed call or invitation toward guidance, with broader summons pressure
words.prose: {{ar:تَدْعُهُمْ}} ({{tr:tadʿuhum}}) shifts address to the caller and targets the sealed group directly. The conditional jussive subordinates the caller's act to a hypothetical test, while the following goal narrows the root's invitation, invocation, and summons pressure to calling them toward guidance after their channels have been blocked.

topics.headline: calling a sealed audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a direct call being made to the very group whose hearts and ears have just been blocked.
topics.reason: QAC identifies second-person jussive under the conditional with plural object suffix; CRITICAL rows connect the communication pair, register shift, and same-surah call contrasts.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition governing guidance as goal while preserving distance from arrival
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) points the call toward guidance without guaranteeing that the distance closes. It also reverses the earlier away-from vector: the person turned away from signs, while the caller now summons toward guidance.

topics.headline: direction without arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the call has a real direction, but direction is not the same as arrival.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the preposition governing the guidance noun; CRITICAL rows preserve the direction-versus-arrival and toward/away geometry.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun naming guidance as the known goal of the call before the same root is denied in action
words.root_gloss_range: root range of guiding, showing the way, leading aright, and gift/bestowal pressure; locally the definite verbal noun selects the offered path or state of guidance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْهُدَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-hudā}}) names the goal before negation shuts it down. The article makes the guidance determinate, and the verbal noun presents a path or state offered toward them; gift pressure from the root can enrich the offer, but the local construction selects guidance as the destination of the call.

topics.headline: known guidance offered before denied self-guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the desired endpoint before it is denied, so the loss is visible before the final closure.
topics.reason: QAC shows a definite verbal noun governed by the directional preposition; CRITICAL rows support the local h-d-y root echo while narrowing gift/bestowal pressure to secondary payoff.

words.gloss_range: result-linking particle that ties the conditional call directly to the negated answer
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge between condition and answer. If the call is made, then the result is immediately stated as non-guidance, turning the conditional into a proof of futility.

topics.headline: apodosis hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the failed guidance as the answer to the imagined call, not as a detached statement.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows identify this particle as the linker of the conditional apodosis.

words.gloss_range: particle of emphatic future negation governing the following guidance verb and beginning the final closure sequence
words.prose: {{ar:لَنْ}} ({{tr:lan}}) begins the final closure. It governs the following subjunctive verb and makes the failure a future impossibility within the imagined condition; with the later final time adverb, it closes every temporal window rather than merely reporting present non-guidance.

topics.headline: emphatic future negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not merely report present non-guidance; it blocks the future prospect after the call.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the negating particle governing the subjunctive verb; CRITICAL rows connect it to the final lan-verb-result-forever closure.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII subjunctive verb under emphatic negation, denying the sealed group's attaining or finding guidance for themselves
words.root_gloss_range: root range of guidance, being shown the way, and finding the path; locally Form VIII emphasizes accepting or finding guidance for oneself under negation
words.prose: {{ar:يَهْتَدُوا}} ({{tr:yahtadū}}) answers the offered guidance with failed self-guidance. Form VIII makes recipient uptake visible: the problem is not that no path was named, but that the sealed group will not find or accept it for themselves.

topics.headline: self-guidance denied after the offered path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even the recipients' own uptake of guidance is denied after the path has been named.
topics.reason: QAC identifies Form VIII subjunctive under the negating particle; CRITICAL rows link the verb to the same-root guidance noun, the blocked organs, and the invitation pattern.

words.gloss_range: result particle reinforcing the apodosis and bridging the negated verb to the final temporal seal
words.prose: {{ar:إِذًا}} ({{tr:idhan}}) keeps the answer consequential. Placed between the negated guidance verb and the final time adverb, it carries the logic of "in that case" into permanent closure.

topics.headline: consequence carried into permanence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the non-guidance framed as the consequence of the condition and prior sealing.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows identify the particle as a response or consequence marker rather than a new independent clause.

words.gloss_range: adverbial accusative of unbounded time closing the conditional answer, with horizon/unreachability pressure kept as image not separate sense
words.root_gloss_range: root range of endless duration, permanence, and remote unreachability; locally the adverb seals negated guidance across all future time
words.prose: {{ar:أَبَدًا}} ({{tr:abadan}}) is the last word and the temporal seal. It extends the negation across the whole future opened by the condition; horizon or unreachability pressure sharpens the closure, but the local function is the adverbial "ever" under negation.

topics.headline: final temporal seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ending with time itself closed against guidance.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an accusative time adverb; CRITICAL rows support the lan-plus-final-adverb formula and same-surah duration contrasts while narrowing horizon imagery to payoff pressure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذُكِّرَ ... فَأَعْرَضَ ... وَنَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: A reminder makes marked material present again, but bodily turning-away interrupts that recovery and leaves the agent's own prior production outside active memory.

activation_trace.role: Recovery after forgetting supplies the attempted return to awareness.
The evident mark supplies what the reminder places before the addressee.
Turning one's side supplies the active interruption rather than passive absence.
Loss from recollection supplies the resulting break in self-account.
Advancing ahead makes prior action something sent forward into the agent's future.
What the two hands earn fixes responsibility in the agent's own production.

changed_reading.before: The person is reminded, turns away, and forgets past deeds.
changed_reading.after: The reminder attempts to restore visibly marked truth, but an enacted turn severs the person from the future already authored by their own hands.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The inner core is covered and the organ of receptive hearing is weighted, so signal can arrive without becoming inward comprehension.

activation_trace.role: Making something assume a condition supplies the configured state of reception.
The core or pith locates the blockage at the inward center rather than at information supply.
A preserving cover supplies the enclosure interposed over the inward core.
Grasping a matter supplies the cognitive operation that the enclosure blocks.
Attentive acceptance of what is heard supplies the receptive gateway.
Auditory heaviness supplies the obstruction at that gateway.

changed_reading.before: They do not understand because their hearts are covered and their ears are deafened.
changed_reading.after: The verse maps a configured reception failure: audible signs reach an ear made unreceptive and therefore never penetrate to the inward act of grasping.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَإِن تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهْتَدُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًا
baseline_models.mechanism: A verbal summons points toward a way, but the emphatic result denies transition into that orientation and extends the non-arrival without an endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies the attempted attraction toward a destination.
Gentle indication of the true road supplies both the offered guidance and the denied uptake.
Direction and intended course turn guidance into a trajectory rather than a datum.
Unbounded duration extends the failed transition beyond a single refusal.

changed_reading.before: Even when called, they will never accept guidance.
changed_reading.after: The call still reaches them, but their response-system cannot convert address into a change of course; the verse diagnoses enduring directional lock.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between growth reduced to wind-scattered fragments and good remainder returning as recompense recasts what the hands advance as a temporal investment whose yield may disperse or endure.

activation_trace.role: Dry broken vegetation supplies the image of a once-coherent yield losing durability.
Wind-driven scattering supplies the dispersal of that yield.
Continuance supplies the opposing durable remainder.
A deed's recompense returning to its doer supplies the future return on what was advanced.
Sending action ahead anchors the temporal contrast in the focus clause.
Neglect supplies the broken feedback between present action and later yield.

structural_cues: 18:45-46 moves from a rapidly dispersed yield to a remainder evaluated by return and hope.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispersal, durability, return, and action sent ahead; I infer that this contrast frames the focus person's forgotten production. Alternatively, the contrast may only rank worldly goods against good deeds without specifying the psychology of forgetting.

changed_reading.before: They forget the bad things they previously did.
changed_reading.after: They lose the temporal feedback by which present handiwork becomes future yield, forgetting both that actions travel ahead and that only some returns endure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Public exposure, an obligatory record, exhaustive counting, and deeds found present make subjective forgetting powerless to erase what the hands advanced.

activation_trace.role: Presentation for sight supplies the public exposure that reverses the focus turning-away.
A written fixation that obligates supplies an external record resistant to memory loss.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies the record's completeness.
Intentional action supplies the very content preserved by the record.
Presence under observation supplies the return of deeds as an immediate object.
Personal loss of recollection anchors the asymmetry between memory and record.
Hand-earned production identifies the recorded material as self-authored.

structural_cues: 18:47-49 progresses from terrain laid bare, to persons presented, to a record placed, to deeds found present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, fixed inscription, exhaustive count, and present deeds; I infer that these form the objective counterpart to focus-memory failure. Alternatively, the focus forgetting could denote culpable disregard without a claim about ordinary recall.

changed_reading.before: Forgetting hides prior deeds from the offender.
changed_reading.after: Forgetting is a private deletion attempt inside a scene of objective conservation: what leaves self-memory remains written, countable, and presentable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Choosing an enemy as protective ally redirects allegiance; the later unanswered call to claimed partners mirrors the focus person's failure to answer a call toward guidance, while the intervening barrier makes the failed relation spatial.

activation_trace.role: Protective love and alliance supply the relation attached to the wrong object.
Enmity identifies that chosen protector as structurally opposed to the chooser.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the misdirecting substitution.
A spoken call supplies the reversed echo of the focus invitation.
Verbal response supplies precisely what the claimed partners fail to return.
A barrier between two sides spatializes the failed relation.
The focus call anchors the reversal in its own invitation-response construction.
Direction and course identify the relation that the focus addressees fail to enter.

structural_cues: 18:50-52 runs from substituted allegiance to a call across an unbridgeable separation; 18:57 reverses caller and called.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wrong alliance, substitution, unanswered address, and separation; I infer a mirrored call-response circuit linking them to the focus invitation. Alternatively, the two calls may be rhetorical parallels without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: The addressees simply refuse the guidance call.
changed_reading.after: Their nonresponse belongs to a miswired allegiance system: having directed reliance toward nonresponding protectors, they become the nonresponders when guidance addresses them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeing the destination, recognizing impending contact, and finding no route of diversion turn the focus denial of guidance into an irreversible trajectory rather than merely failed assent.

activation_trace.role: Direct sight supplies recognition of the destination.
Certainty reached from an evident sign supplies recognition of imminent contact.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies convergence upon the seen end.
Turning something away supplies the unavailable diversion.
Course and direction anchor the destination logic in the focus guidance clause.
Remaining without departure supplies persistence on the locked course.

structural_cues: 18:53 sequences sight, inferred arrival, and failure to find a diversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a seen endpoint, expected contact, and no diversion; I map that spatial sequence onto the focus root's course-image. Alternatively, 18:53 may describe only punishment while 18:57 concerns epistemic response.

changed_reading.after: They remain on a convergent course toward an end they will eventually see, while the alternative route repeatedly indicated to them cannot be entered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeatedly varied examples meet no external barrier to trust, yet are counterprocessed through tightly wound dispute, attempted displacement of truth, and mockery; the focus coverings therefore read as the settled state of an active defensive practice.

activation_trace.role: Turning discourse through multiple forms supplies abundant variation in presentation.
An example functioning as admonitory sign supplies material designed for recognition.
Twisted, interlocking contention supplies the defensive processing mode.
A barrier between a person and a desired end supplies the explicitly negated external blocker.
Heart-settling trust supplies the uptake that nevertheless does not occur.
Concealing the truth supplies the aim of the defensive practice.
Making an argument lose its footing supplies the attempted removal of truth from its place.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what the disputation attempts to dislodge.
Mockery supplies the affective seal on argumentative rejection.
The inward cover anchors the resulting defensive enclosure in the focus.
Blocked grasping identifies the cognitive cost of that enclosure.

structural_cues: 18:54-56 moves from varied examples, through the question of what prevents trust, to active dispute and ridicule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated presentation, no independent blocker, contentious counteruse, concealment, and mockery; I infer that these practices sediment into the focus nonreceptive state. Alternatively, the coverings may be a consequence imposed independently rather than a habit formed by argument.

changed_reading.before: The coverings simply explain why the audience cannot understand.
changed_reading.after: The coverings are the settled architecture of counter-understanding: discourse is heard, twisted into contest, used to destabilize truth, and thereby prevented from reaching inward grasp.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgiving mercy delays external seizure for what is earned, while an appointed endpoint remains; this separates the focus's present cognitive consequence from immediate punishment without canceling eventual accountability.

activation_trace.role: Covering a fault while protecting its bearer supplies non-immediate punishment.
Tender mercy supplies the reason for temporal restraint.
Taking to account for a fault supplies the withheld external consequence.
Acquired gain supplies the accountable product corresponding to what hands advanced.
Acceleration and bringing forward supply the explicitly denied immediacy.
An appointment fixed by time supplies the retained endpoint.
Refuge and escape supply what will not be available at that endpoint.
Falling into destruction supplies the realized endpoint after delay.
The presently made condition anchors the distinction between cognitive state and delayed seizure.
Hand-earned production links the delayed account to the focus person's own action.

structural_cues: 18:58 delays requital despite earnings, while 18:59 pairs wrongdoing with an appointed destruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, withheld acceleration, earnings, appointment, and later destruction; I infer a distinction between present cognitive consequence and deferred external punishment. Alternatively, the focus coverings and the later delay may be parallel divine acts without a staged relation.

changed_reading.before: The imposed coverings are immediate punishment and the final word on the offenders.
changed_reading.after: A cognitive consequence can already operate while external requital is mercifully deferred; delay preserves an interval, but not an escape from the appointed account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the immediate ear construction strongly favors auditory impairment, yet the same focus root also names a carried load and the surrounding record makes self-produced deeds present; retain it only as a secondary material overlay, not as a replacement for deafness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا beside مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ

activation_trace.role: A carried heavy load supplies a material overlay for the ear's burden.
What the hands earn identifies a possible source for the figurative load.
Obligating inscription supplies preservation of the burden beyond recollection.
Deeds made present supply the eventual manifestation of what was carried.
Acquisition through action reinforces the burden as self-produced rather than arbitrary.

changed_reading.before: The ears contain a heaviness that prevents hearing.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary overlay, the ears are burdened by the accumulated weight of what the hands earned, so prior production itself helps make corrective hearing difficult.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because جِنّ in 18:50 does not itself mean a shield, but its inventory carries concealment and protective-cover images that resonate with أَكِنَّةً, wrong alliance, and the later absence of refuge; render only as an exploratory spatial analogy.

activation_trace.role: A sheltering cover supplies the focus image of an enclosed inward space.
A protective shield supplies the exploratory analogue for refuge sought in the concealed ally.
Alliance and protection assign that shelter-image to a chosen relationship.
Substitution supplies the counterfeit character of the protection.
The denied refuge supplies the eventual failure of every protective enclosure.

changed_reading.before: The heart-coverings are only barriers placed over cognition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the coverings resemble an inward counterfeit refuge built around wrong allegiance: it shelters rejection from guidance now but cannot shelter its bearer at the appointed end.

strongest_changes: The forgotten handiwork remains objectively conserved as inscription, count, and present deed.
Guidance becomes a course-change problem sharpened by a seen endpoint and the absence of diversion.
The heart-and-ear blockage reads as the settled result-state of active argumentative counterprocessing, not scarcity of signs.
summary.what_was_special: The local sequence repeatedly reverses the focus actions: turning away meets public exposure, forgetting meets exhaustive presence, refusing a call meets unanswered calling, and imagined shelter meets no refuge.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle whether the coverings are habit formed, judicial consequence, or both.
The mirrored calls in 18:52 and 18:57 may be structural analogy rather than causal sequence.
The acoustic-load and counterfeit-refuge readings are branch-valid overlays but remain form-distant.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Rejected reminder hardens into an assigned state.** `ذ ك ر` B009 (“reminder or admonition”) is followed by turning away and forgetting; then `ج ع ل` B002 assigns covers and weight to heart and ears. The cave’s closed ears preserved receptive youths (18:11), whereas these closures follow refusal. I infer a feedback arrow from practiced evasion to incapacitated understanding. Identical sensory blockage has opposite moral function because its causal history differs.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:101 completed the progression from rejected reminder to embodied inability to hear.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Protection inverted into epistemic insulation.** `ك ن ن/B001` is protective cover and preservation; `ك ن ن/B003` is remaining under cover. Here the covers sit on hearts to block understanding, paired with weighted ears; the prior ayah describes truth being made to slip, and 18:61–62 soon stages a missed sign followed by passage beyond it. I infer that repeated turning away converts a normally protective boundary into a self-sealing perceptual environment. `أَكِنَّة` reads as hardened insulation produced through refusal, not neutral absence of information.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:58 surprisingly restored covering as mercy: unlike 18:57’s insulation, forgiving cover preserves response-time rather than blocking access.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The narrative gift of a remembrance is only broadly related to its rejection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its protective sleep and testing of hearts offer a limited contrast to the focus's closed hearts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Supplies the positive counterpoint: those reminded of their Lord's signs are not deaf and blind before them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The direction of prayer does not clarify the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its rebuke for remembering little is only a limited echo.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The bee's inspired dwelling places do not clarify the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The warning about making water brackish does not clarify the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's sealing of hearts and hearing directly parallels the focus's divinely imposed incapacity after rejection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Deafness, dumbness, and blindness together portray an irreversible failure to return to guidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The image of those who hear only a call, while deaf, dumb, and blind to meaning, closely illuminates failed understanding.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Hearts becoming harder than stone offers a related image of inward resistance to divine address.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The warning about hearts that deviate identifies an inner disposition that seeks away from clear guidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Sealed hearts are explicitly linked to unbelief, closely matching the focus's punitive closure.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Hard hearts, distortion, and forgetting part of what was reminded connect rejection to the loss of guiding memory.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Blindness and deafness after assuming there would be no trial directly parallel failed reception of signs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Only those who truly listen can respond, supplying the receptive contrast to the focus's deafness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those who deny the signs are deaf and dumb in darkness, a close parallel to the focus's blocked perception.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The removal of hearing and sight and sealing of hearts directly develops the focus's sensory and inward closure.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Hearts and eyes are turned away because they did not believe at first encounter with the signs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Arrogance leads people to turn from God's signs, reject guidance, and take the path of error instead.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Hearts that do not understand, eyes that do not see, and ears that do not hear form a comprehensive parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The sealing of hearts of those who do not learn from past peoples reinforces culpable failure to heed signs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The worst creatures are deaf and dumb people who do not use reason, directly relevant to the focus's non-understanding.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Even if made to hear, they would turn away, distinguishing mere hearing from responsive reception.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to answer God and the Messenger presents the active response that the focus's addressees refuse.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Hearts sealed through preferring to remain behind gives a related account of incapacity to know.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those content to stay behind have their hearts sealed and therefore do not know.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Repeated denial of prior signs is followed by the sealing of transgressors' hearts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Hearts, hearing, and sight are sealed or covered, and heedlessness results, closely matching the focus's threefold closure.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Qur'an's repeated reminders increase some people only in aversion, directly clarifying rejection after reminder.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: A hidden veil is placed between the recitation of the Qur'an and those who disbelieve in the Hereafter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Blindness in this life leads to greater blindness from the path in the Hereafter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: A heart made heedless of divine remembrance follows desire and oversteps bounds, a particularly close neighbouring formulation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Qur'an's healing for believers but increased loss for wrongdoers gives a broader outcome contrast.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Turning away from the divine reminder makes a person bear a burden on the Day of Resurrection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Turning away from God's remembrance brings a constricted life and resurrection in blindness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Diversified warnings are given so people may be mindful, directly supplying the purpose frustrated in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly distinguishes eyes from hearts that understand and ears that hear, closely explaining the focus's inward deafness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Questions whether most people truly hear or reason, describing them as more astray than cattle.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The believers' response when called to divine judgement is to hear and obey, the positive counterpoint to turning away.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The dead cannot be made to hear, nor can the deaf hear a call when they turn their backs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The blind cannot be guided from error; only those who believe in the signs can be made to hear.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The revelation is clear signs held in the breasts of those given knowledge, contrasting inward receptivity with covered hearts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Reiterates that the deaf cannot hear a call when they turn away, closely matching the focus's refusal of guidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God seals the hearts of those who do not know, another direct account of cognitive closure.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those reminded of their Lord's signs respond in prostration without arrogance, the focus's clearest positive counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Barriers before and behind, with a covering over the eyes, form a strong image of being unable to see the way.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Warning or not warning becomes equivalent for those who will not believe, echoing the focus's final incapacity.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The best discourse causes receptive skins and hearts to soften to God's remembrance, directly opposing hard or covered hearts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Hearts of Hereafter-deniers shrink when God alone is mentioned, a related aversion to divine remembrance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God seals every arrogant, tyrannical heart, tying closure to the focus's moral diagnosis.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Turning away from the remembrance of the Most Merciful results in an attached devil, extending the consequence of neglect.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Following desire is joined to sealing hearing and heart and placing a cover over sight.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Granted hearing, sight, and hearts prove useless when people reject God's signs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Some listen only superficially, then leave; their hearts are sealed and they follow desires.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The alternative to reflecting on the Qur'an is locks upon hearts, directly relevant to the focus's inability to understand.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Turning back after guidance has become clear is attributed to deceptive false hope.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A reminder benefits one who has a heart or listens while present, defining the receptive condition absent in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Believers are warned not to let their hearts harden with time after remembrance comes to them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: When people deviate, God causes their hearts to deviate, closely paralleling consequential inward closure.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The donkey carrying books depicts possession of revelation without understanding or living by its signs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Disbelief after professed belief results in sealed hearts that no longer understand.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The inhabitants of the Fire admit that hearing or reasoning would have kept them from their fate.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: People turn away from the reminder in alarm, a direct behavioural parallel to the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Their flight from the reminder intensifies the image of active rejection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: One who fears will heed the reminder, supplying the responsive contrast to those who never find guidance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: What people have earned rusts over their hearts, connecting prior deeds to an obscured inner faculty.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Rejection is enacted by layers over organs of reception, preventing reminder from becoming understanding, sight, or hearing.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The obstacle is portrayed less as missing information than as an architecture that prevents information from entering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Self-Produced Neglect Hardens into Covered Hearts and Heavy Ears
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Turning from reminder and neglecting prior deeds culminate in covers over hearts and weight in ears, so renewed calls cannot yield guidance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; lateral turning `ع ر ض:B005/m01`; deliberate neglect `ن س ي:B002/m01`; sending deeds ahead `ق د م:B004/m01`; hand-produced consequence `ي د ي:B009/m01`; heart-intellect `ق ل ب:B001/m01`; enclosing cover `ك ن ن:B001/m01`; penetrative understanding `ف ق ه:B001/m01`; receptive ear `ء ذ ن:B001/m01`; blocking weight `و ق ر:B001/m01`; summons `د ع و:B001/m01`; gentle direction `ه د ي:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:57 (turning from reminder, forgetting what the hands sent ahead, heart covers, ear weight, and futile call to guidance)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Occlusion has a moral history. The bodily barriers manifest an earlier sequence of turning and neglect, after which additional address encounters a receiver no longer able to process it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Remembrance Reopens a Route While Neglect Seals It
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A lapse remains reversible when recollection redirects action, but deliberate neglect converts the absent reminder into a durable closure of reception.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Forgetting is classified by its sequel rather than by the lapse alone: return distinguishes recoverable absence from entrenched abandonment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Neglected Reminder Becomes a Closed Sensory System
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Treating prior deeds and reminder as things to leave behind culminates in covered hearts, weighted ears, covered eyes, and incapacity to hear.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deliberate neglect `ن س ي:B002/m01`; received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; lateral turning `ع ر ض:B005/m01`; enclosing cover `ك ن ن:B001/m01`; blocking weight `و ق ر:B001/m01`; visual covering `غ ط و:B001/m01`; auditory reception `س م ع:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:57 (turning, neglect, heart covers, and ear weight); 18:101 (eyes covered from reminder and inability to hear)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Neglect reverses the restorative sequence. Instead of memory reopening a path to what was missed, repeated exclusion builds a receiver in which reminder can no longer arrive as actionable knowledge.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Boundaries Are Judged by the Traffic They Control
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Thresholds, covers, walls, and enclosures take their moral polarity from what they admit, preserve, obstruct, or trap.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The whole-surah pattern places physical architecture and sensory reception under one functional test without erasing their distinct scenes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A Protective Form Is Reversed into Cognitive Closure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Covers that would ordinarily preserve an interior instead preserve it from reminder, pairing heart and eye closure with blocked hearing.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: enclosing cover `ك ن ن:B001/m01`; blocking weight `و ق ر:B001/m01`; visual covering `غ ط و:B001/m01`; auditory reception `س م ع:B001/m01`; received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; penetrative understanding `ف ق ه:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:57 (heart covers, ear weight, and failed understanding); 18:101 (covered eyes and inability to hear)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The geometry resembles protection, but its object is inverted. The barrier now keeps corrective address outside, turning preservation into epistemic loss.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Boundaries Are Judged by the Traffic They Control
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Thresholds, covers, walls, and enclosures take their moral polarity from what they admit, preserve, obstruct, or trap.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The whole-surah pattern places physical architecture and sensory reception under one functional test without erasing their distinct scenes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Closing the Ear Preserves Sleep but Can Also Seal Guidance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The same sensory gate is divinely restrained to preserve sleepers, then morally weighted until guidance cannot enter, and finally paired with complete inability to hear.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ear as receptive opening `ء ذ ن:B001/m01`; imposed restraint `ض ر ب:B004/m01`; blocking weight `و ق ر:B001/m01`; received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; auditory reception `س م ع:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:11 (restraint upon the sleepers' ears); 18:57 (weight in ears blocks guidance); 18:101 (inability to hear)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Closure has opposite value according to purpose and agency. Temporary restraint protects a vulnerable state, whereas acquired heaviness preserves the hearer from the very address that could restore direction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Restricted comprehension can harden into permanent exclusion or be overcome through communicative adaptation and cooperative work.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Minimal shared speech can support protection where abundant reminder fails against willful closure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covered Reception Prevents Understanding and Guidance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Turning and neglect produce heart covers and ear weight so that reminder cannot become understood guidance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: penetrative understanding `ف ق ه:B001/m01`; enclosing cover `ك ن ن:B001/m01`; blocking weight `و ق ر:B001/m01`; received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; gentle direction `ه د ي:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:57 (covered hearts, weighted ears, failed understanding, and failed guidance)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The limitation is internally reinforced. More address cannot compensate because the channels required to process it are themselves the objects of closure.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الذكر والذكورة والذكران وولادة الذكور والمذكار وما شبه بالذكر في الخلقة.
يدخل فيه الحديد الذكر والسيف المذكر وذكور البقل وما وصف بالشدة والقوة كالرجل الذكر واليوم والطريق والداهية والمطر.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi unutmanın karşıtı olarak bir şeyi zihinde tutmayı, unutulanı yeniden bilince getirmeyi ve kaybolan bilgiyi arayıp bulmayı birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve zihinsel süreç ile korunmuş bellek durumunu doğru biçimde birleştirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Zihinsel çekirdek korunur; akılda olma, yeniden hatırlama, ezber çalışması ve iyi bellek nitelemeleri kendi yapılarına bağlı yüzlerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi unutmayacak biçimde zihinde tutmak veya unutulan bilgiyi yeniden bilince getirmektir. Buna bağlı kullanımlar, kayıp bilgiyi aramayı ve belleği korumak için çalışmayı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir bilginin zihinde korunması ve unutmanın karşıtı olarak hazır bulunmasıdır.
Unutulmuş veya gözden uzaklaşmış bir bilgiyi yeniden bilince getirme eylemidir.
Kaybolan bilgiyi zihinde arama ve öğrenileni bellekte tutmak için çalışma süreçlerini kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar unutmanın karşıtı olan zihinsel korumayı, unutulanı geri çağırmayı ve kaybolan bilgiyi yeniden bulma çabasını tek bir bellek alanında toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem bellekte koruma durumunu hem de unutulanı etkin biçimde geri çağırma sürecini birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Zihinde saklama, unutmaya karşı koruma ve yeniden bilince getirme işlemlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Unutulmuş veya o sırada düşünülmeyen bir şey yeniden bilince geldiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgiyi yeniden bilince getirme eylemini doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Bilgiyi sürekli akılda tutma ve ezber için çalışma yüzlerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir bilgi ya da yükümlülüğün unutulmadan bellekte korunması istendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilginin bellekte hazır ve korunmuş bulunması anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Unutulanı etkin olarak geri çağırma ve arama sürecini kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: belleği güçlü, yiğit veya iyi anılan adam

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak bir bilginin bellekte bulunmasını veya yeniden bilince gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu bir bilginin bellekten kaybolmasını ve sahibince erişilememesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bilginin bellekte bulunup bulunmaması ekseninde karşı karşıya gelir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak bellekte varlık ve erişimi, komşu ise aynı varlık ve erişimin kaybını bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak unutulan bilgiyi etkin biçimde geri çağırma sürecini de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu işitilen veya öğrenilen şeyin zihinde sağlam biçimde yerleşmesini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bilginin unutulmadan zihinde bulunması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu daha çok bilginin yerleşik korunmasına, odak ise hem korumaya hem yeniden geri çağırmaya uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak genel olarak akılda tutmayı ve unutulanı hatırlamayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu bir metne bakmadan ezbere bilme durumuyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bilginin zihinde hazır bulunması bakımından buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ezbere bilme dış kaynağa ihtiyaç duymayan yerleşik öğrenmeyi gerektirir; odak böyle bir öğrenme koşulu olmadan da hatırlamayı kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak bilginin zihinde bulunması veya geri çağrılması sonucunu içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu bir sözü belleğe yerleştirmek için içten yineleme eylemini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İçten yineleme, bilginin hatırlanmasını ve bellekte tutulmasını destekleyebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu bir çalışma yöntemi ve yineleme sürecidir; odak ise yönteme bağlı olmadan bellek durumu ile geri çağırmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak kişinin zihninde gerçekleşen hatırlama ve akılda tutma durumudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu bir başkasında ya da kişinin kendisinde hatırlamayı doğuran uyarı, araç veya eylemdir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal unutulan bilginin yeniden zihinde hazır olması sonucunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak zihinsel sonuç ve süreçtir; komşu bu sonucu meydana getiren neden veya hatırlatıcıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan on dört adayın tümü değerlendirildi; bellek eksenini en iyi açıklayan beş ilişki seçildi, tanıma, düşünme, eski tanışıklık ve diğer kardeş dallar daha uzak veya yinelenen kaldı.
branches.branch_image_ar: استحضار الشيء بعد النسيان أو مع الحفظ
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحفظ والاستحضار بالقلب والتذكر والاستذكار وما يكون خلاف النسيان.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ذكرت الشيء خلاف نسيته (maqayis;sihah)؛ الذكر الحفظ للشيء وهو مني على ذكر (ayn;tahdhib)؛ ذكر بالقلب والتذكر طلب ما فات (ayn;tahdhib;mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ذكر الشيء باللسان والقول والإظهار والتسمية، ومنه ذكر الناس بخير أو بسوء إذا دل السياق.
يدخل فيه الصلاة والدعاء والثناء والتسبيح والشكر والطاعة وقراءة القرآن من حيث هي ذكر لله.

branches.branch_image_ar: الذكر كتاب منزل أو كتاب دين
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكتاب الذي فيه تفصيل الدين وكل كتاب للأنبياء والقرآن والكتب المتقدمة.
يدخل فيه الشرف والعلاء والصيت والثناء وحسن الذكر.
يدخل فيه ذكر الحق بمعنى الصك وجمعه ذكور حقوق أو ذكور حق.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız hatırlatan bir nesneyi değil, başkasında hatırlamayı meydana getirme eylemini, hatırlamaya yarayan aracı ve bazı biçimlerde sık anmayı birlikte verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici nesne merkezli çerçeve bu süreç ve yoğunluk yüzlerini açıkça kapsayacak biçimde genişletilmelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hatırlatma eylemi, hatırlatıcı araç ve sık anma ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur; bu yapıların hiçbiri yalın zihinsel hatırlamayla özdeşleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir bilginin yeniden zihinde belirmesini sağlamak veya buna yarayan bir işaret ya da araç sunmaktır. Belirli bir biçim ayrıca bir şeyi sıkça anmayı anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Bir başkasında veya kişinin kendisinde unutulmuş bilginin yeniden hatırlanmasını sağlar.
Bir ihtiyacı veya bilgiyi hatırlamaya yarayan işaret, not ya da araç olarak gerçekleşir.
Belirli bir ad biçiminde bir şeyi sık ve yoğun biçimde anma anlamı taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hatırlatmayı başkasında hatırlama meydana getiren geçişli eylem ve hatırlamaya yarayan araç olarak verir; ayrıca belirli biçimde sık anma yoğunluğunu kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: hatırlatma, hatırlamayı sağlayan araç ve sıkça anma

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalniz soyut isaret degil, kisinin sahsi, topluca cikma, kitap parcasini olusturan harf toplulugu ve gunes isigini de ayni ailede verir. Dal adi kullanilabilir, fakat tanim isaret cekirdegini bu adlasmis ve kalipli uzantilardan ayirmalidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mixed non-bare kapsam, yalniz ciplak isaret anlamini degil, kalipli kisi, topluluk, metin parcasi ve gunes isigi kullanimlarini ayri facetlerde tutar.

concept_map.definition: Gorunen bir belirti veya isaret; bazi kalipli kullanimlarda kisinin sahsi, toplulugun butunu, kitapta harflerden olusan parca ya da gunesin isigi icin de kullanilir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir seyi tanitan veya ona delalet eden gorunen belirtidir.
Kisinin sahsi, onun taninmasini saglayan belirti gibi dusunulerek ifade edilir.
Bir toplulugun eksiksiz butunu icin de kullanilir.
Kitapta harf toplulugundan olusan belirli parca anlamina gelir.
Gunes isigi, gunesin ayirt ettirici belirtisi gibi goruldugu icin bu alana baglanir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar isaret ve belirti cekirdeginde bulusur; ayni iddia kisinin sahsi, toplulugun butunu, kitap parcasi ve gunes isigi gibi uzantilari da birlikte aktarir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الآية بمعنى العلامة، وآية الرجل بمعنى شخصه، وخروج القوم بآيتهم أي بجماعتهم، وآية القرآن لأنها جماعة حروف، وإياة الشمس بمعنى ضوئها كالعلامة لها.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أي في الاستفهام والجزاء والصلة والنعت والتعجب وحكاية النكرات، وما يتصل بها من أيهم وأيما وأية.
يدخل فيه إيا مع الكاف والهاء والياء في موضع الاسم المنصوب، كإياك، وذكرها عمادا للضمير في التحذير وغيره.
يدخل فيه أيان إذا جعلت بمنزلة متى للسؤال عن الزمان، مع الخلاف في نونها أهي أصلية أم زائدة.
يدخل فيه كأين أو كائن في معنى كم، مع الكاف الزائدة والنون التي تشبه التنوين أو تكون مع أي أصلا.
يدخل فيه أي في نداء القريب، وأيا في نداء القريب والبعيد، وآي الممدودة في النداء.
يدخل فيه أي التي تتقدم تفسير المعنى، كقولهم أي كذا وكذا أو أي بمعنى تريد كذا.
يدخل فيه إي المكسورة التي تدخل في اليمين أو تتقدم القسم بمعنى نعم أو بلى.

يدخل فيه الرباني والربانيون بمعنى العلماء والحكماء وأهل العلم بالرب أو من يرب العلم ونفسه به
يدخل فيه الربة والجماعات الكثيرة، والربيون إذا فسروا بالألوف أو الجماعات، ورباب القبائل لاجتماعهم
يدخل فيه الربيب والربيبة للولد المربوب من زوج سابق، والراب والرابة لمن يقوم على أمره، والحاضنة
يدخل فيه الرُّبّ الطلاء الخاثر أو ثفل السمن والزيت، والسقاء والنحي والأديم والدواء والطعام إذا جعل فيه الرُّبّ أو أصلح به

يدخل فيه الرباب والربابة للسحاب، والسحاب المتعلق أو المركب بعضه على بعض، وما سمي بذلك لتربية النبات أو دوام المطر
يدخل فيه الشاة الرُّبّى والرباب لقرب العهد بالولادة أو لزوم البيت للبن، وربان الشيء بمعنى حدثانه وطراءته، وربى الشباب
يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
يدخل فيه الربابة والرباب للعهد والميثاق والجوار، والأربة للمعاهدين، والرباب للعشور إذا جعل كالعهد
يدخل فيه الربة والربب لضرب من الشجر أو النبت أو البقلة التي تبقى خضراء
يدخل فيه الربب للماء الكثير، ويقال للعذب، من جهة اجتماع الماء

يدخل فيه رب وربما وربت وربه كحرف خافض أو حرف معنى للتقليل، ودخول ما أو التاء أو الهاء عليه
يدخل فيه الربى بمعنى الحاجة، والرابة، والعقدة المحكمة، والنعمة والإحسان

root_profile.summary: Kök, sahiplik ve yetiştirmeden topluluk, aile bağı, kalıcılık, bulut, yiyecek maddesi, sözleşme, bitki, su, hayvan sürüsü, dil bilgisel öğe ve gemi yönetimine uzanan on yedi ayrı anlam dalı taşır. Dalların çoğu yönetme, bir araya getirme veya süreklilik çağrışımlarıyla gevşekçe ilişkilense de sözlükte bağımsız sınırlar gerektirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ربا الشيء إذا زاد أو ارتفع، وربت الأرض إذا انتفخت وزادت، والرابي الزائد أو العالي، وأربى عليه إذا أشرف أو زاد عليه.
يدخل فيه الربوة والرابية والرباوة والرباة وما ارتفع من الأرض، مع اختلاف لغات الكلمة.
يدخل فيه الربا في البيع أو القرض، والزيادة على رأس المال، والربية لغة أو اسم خاص للربا.
يدخل فيه الربو بمعنى النفس العالي أو البهر أو الانبهار، وما يصيب الإنسان أو الدابة من علو النفس أو الانتفاخ من مشي أو عدو أو فزع.
يدخل فيه ربيت الولد أو تربيته بمعنى غذوته، وربا الولد أو الزرع بالنماء، وربوت أو ربيت في القوم بمعنى نشأت فيهم.
يدخل فيه الأربية أو الأربيتان بمعنى أصل الفخذ أو لحمتين ناتئتين في أصول الفخذين من باطن.
يدخل فيه قولهم جاء في أربية قومه أي في أهل بيته من بني الأعمام ونحوهم.

root_profile.summary: Kökün merkezinde artma ve yükselme bulunur; bu çekirdek yükselmiş araziye, işlemde anaparayı aşan koşullu fazlalığa, yükselip sıkışan soluğa ve beslenerek büyümeye uzanır. Ayrıca uyluk kökü anatomisi ile baba tarafından yakın hane halkını anlatan dar bir ifade, merkezden ayrı sözlüksel dallar oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasının görmesine veya değerlendirmesine sunmayı; mal, asker ve kitap gibi belirli nesnelerle açıkça örnekler. Dalın kimliği kendiliğinden görünme değil, bir failin yönelttiği sunmadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, nesnenin birine, satışa veya incelemeye sunulduğu yapılara bağlıdır; yalın kök anlamı olarak genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka birinin görmesi, incelemesi, okuması veya değerlendirmesi için onun önüne getirmek ya da belirli bir amaca sunmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir fail, bir nesneyi muhatabın görmesi veya değerlendirmesi için ortaya koyar.
Malın satışa sunulması, askerin denetlenmesi ve kitabın okunup karşılaştırılması bu yapının özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, bir nesnenin bir muhataba veya belirli bir değerlendirme alanına bilinçli biçimde sunulmasıdır; satış, denetim ve okuma bunun özel bağlamlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin muhataba, satışa, denetime ya da okumaya çıkarıldığı yapıların tümünü kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Failin yönelttiği sunmayı ve değerlendirme amacını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi başkasına göstermek ve değerlendirmeye açmak anlamında örtüşür.
